I'm Sorry 🥺

My Dearest Madam Jii 💗

I'm truly sorry if I hurt you, upset you, or made you feel bad. 🥺

I never wanted to be the reason behind your sadness. I know that saying sorry cannot instantly fix everything, but I genuinely regret my mistakes.

You mean a lot to me, and I don't want a misunderstanding or my careless words to create distance between us.

I'll try to understand you better and be more thoughtful with my words and actions.

Please forgive me, Madam Jii. 🕊️💐

With care and a sincere apology,
Your silly person ♡
